svg.title: Software factory architecture: triage, agent guidance and factory policy
svg.desc: Triage checks intent, risk and eligibility before execution. Rules and skills guide delivery and review agents; factory policies govern authorization, including PR auto-approval. Human authority governs delivery and factory improvement. Shared observability links incidents to changes, sessions, retrieved context and environment versions. Failure replay supplies candidate protected reference cases. Memory separates working context, candidate lessons and validated knowledge. Execution and verification environments support delivery, reviewers and factory evaluations. Checker changes require protected evaluation, independent authorization and staged adoption.
svg.text: Deliver software. Automatically improve the factory that delivers it. Keep human authority explicit.
HUMAN PLANE / SET DIRECTION, AUTHOR DEFINITIONS, OBSERVE AND GOVERN
Author files; observe and govern changes.
Set permissions, budgets and escalation rights.
One evidence layer for human oversight and automatic factory improvement.
